## Variables

### Presence

```ts
const Presence: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  object & HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>;
```

Content that arrives and leaves instead of popping: it makes room, fades in
while travelling the theme's `--stipe-motion-distance`, and on leaving fades out
and gives its room back before it unmounts. Reduced motion keeps a short fade
only.

---

### Collapse

```ts
const Collapse: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  object & HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>;
```

Content that opens and closes its own space: an inserted alert, a field error, a
disclosure body. Height and opacity follow the theme's tempo; under reduced
motion the space changes at once and only the fade remains.

---

### Swap

```ts
const Swap: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  object & HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
>;
```

One piece of content replaced by another without a hard cut: loading to loaded,
"Saving…" to "Saved". The old content fades out (blurred by the theme's
`--stipe-motion-blur`) as the new one arrives, and the box eases to the new
size. Reduced motion keeps the crossfade and drops the travel.
